M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation
Chapter 3 Overview

his chapter explores the core policy instruments and tools that drive sustainable energy transitions, structured across three categories: regulatory (command-and-control), market-based, and contractual/procurement mechanisms.
It examines how tools like Renewable Portfolio Standards, Carbon Taxes, Feed-in Tariffs, and Power Purchase Agreements can be designed to align with national contexts and development priorities.
